title: Naturality from ordinary tensor resolution transport
statement: K-flat resolution transport data imply naturality of the extended ordinary tensor model.

source.place: Native tensor transport, geometric tensor part of step 1; K-flat replacement extension.

proof.text: Apply the supplied hresolution hypothesis to g, obtaining K-flat K and K′, quasi-isomorphism augmentations q and q′, a lift a, and a homotopy a ≫ q′ ∼ q ≫ g. DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_of_homotopy gives equality of the localized augmentation composites.

Prove ordinaryTensorMap_comp privately by the total-complex coproduct inclusions and naturality of the curried tensor. Apply mapBifunctorMapHomotopy₂ to f and the augmentation homotopy, then DerivedCategory.Q_map_eq_of_homotopy, to identify the two localized total-tensor composites.

Precompose the desired square with S.tensor.map(Q.map q, identity). This morphism is invertible because q is a quasi-isomorphism. Functoriality and the localized roof equality move the augmentation to the target. Apply htransport, hkflat on f and a, the total-tensor composite equality, and htransport at the source. Cancel the precomposition to conclude. The elementary cancellation calculation is packaged in the proved private lemma naturality_of_transport.

proof_origin.place: Common-roof transport argument formalized directly from the theorem hypotheses, using Mathlib homotopy invariance and total-complex naturality.
